text: 当前共有 30 个活跃事件。要点包括: 阿莫迪口嗨AI减速，这边Opus 5.2疑似已灰测; 消息称三星电子调整定制HBM基础芯片供应链，或推行“双轨”战略; MediaTek unveils the Dimensity 9600 Pro, its first phone SoC on TSMC's 2nm node, and the 3nm 9600M, with boosted AI performance, as it competes with Qualcomm (Wen-Yee Lee/Reuters); Apple brings a fully revamped Siri built on Google's Gemini, but not to the EU; AI巨头，盯上“金融牛马”。
